visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of multiple printed ID photo sheets. A young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a red v-neck cardigan and a thin necklace, appears in the photos. The sheets are laid on a light-colored textured surface. A metal key is also visible on the side. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor street during the day under bright daylight. A yellow subway exit sign reads "4 Sangsu Station". A woman in a pink shirt and a man in a white t-shirt walk away on a sidewalk paved with red and yellow bricks. (3) The camera follows a path up grey stone stairs leading to a building entrance. A black sign with red text "SISA FOCUS TV" is mounted on the wall. A small white sign with "tae.do" and an arrow points toward the door. (4) Inside, the camera pans across a bright white studio. It features a large rectangular mirror, a white chest of drawers, a wooden chair, and professional photography equipment including a black umbrella light on a tripod and a camera directed at a blue backdrop. (5) The main woman is seated, facing away from the camera initially, then toward it. A female staff member wearing a cream-colored knitted sweater stands over her, meticulously smoothing her hair and adjusting the neckline of her red cardigan. (6) The woman poses in front of a blue gradient background, looking into the camera lens. She raises her arms to touch her hair. Yellow variety-show style text overlays appear with heart and star emojis at the top and center of the frame. (7) The visual shifts to a close-up of a desktop monitor. The Adobe Photoshop interface is open, showing a portrait of the woman. A hand moves a digital pen over a tablet to retouch the skin around her eyes and cheeks. (8) An Epson ink-tank printer is shown in a close-up shot. A white sheet of glossy photo paper emerges from the front slot, slowly revealing multiple rows of small, high-quality color printed portraits of the woman in her vibrant red cardigan. (9) The woman's hand, featuring dark-painted fingernails, holds a clear plastic envelope containing her finished photos. Inside, a business card with a star logo and a blue feather-like decoration are visible. The background shows a neutral-toned beige carpet in a room. (10) The final sequence presents a high-resolution digital version of the professional ID photo against a smooth blue gradient background. This is followed by a creative shot of the photo placed inside a nostalgic blue and white "Tamagotchi" style graphic frame.
